name: taskliner
description: Manage tasks in a single line with HH:mm format.

scripts.test:task-line: rm -rf .test-dist && esbuild src/core/task-line.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.test-dist/task-line.cjs && node tests/task-line.test.cjs && rm -rf .test-dist
scripts.test:techo: rm -rf .test-dist && esbuild src/core/techo.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=.test-dist/techo.cjs && node tests/techo.test.cjs && rm -rf .test-dist
scripts.test: npm run test:task-line && npm run test:techo
